'''Alexandre Dufresne Hunt Down and Destroy Then''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Alexandre Dufresne]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-10025">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10025 Hunt Down and Destroy Then], DeckTech (Alexandre "Lord Kenobi" Dufresne, 30 August 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/10025/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/10025/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018125621/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10025/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Alexandre Dufresne]]
* '''Published:''' 30 August 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Hunt Down and Destroy Then''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}

* '''Strategy:''' This is a Hunt Down and Destroy The Jedi deck.

== Original post ==

'''Hunt Down and Destroy Then'''
* '''Author:''' Alexandre "Lord Kenobi" Dufresne
* '''Published:''' August 30, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 3.5
* '''Description:''' This is a Hunt Down and Destroy The Jedi deck.

=== Strategy ===

I don`t have any strategy yet accept Hunt Down and destroy your opponent in space, and on the ground.

PS. The title should have said Hunt Down and Destroy Them not Hunt Down and Destroy then.
